introEyebrow: You don’t need to be a server expert.
introBody: Meet two friends, a helpful AI, and a few very sneaky messages. Build defenses one choice at a time—and find out what happens when a bot gets fooled.
introMeta: {n} short missions · No code · No timer · Mistakes welcome
meetBody: A stolen account. A tricky document. A secret in the wrong place.
decideBody: Choose what to allow, protect, or shut down.
learnBody: Unlock a defense and learn a useful idea.
operatorNote: You can learn the operator’s choices without becoming an operator.
sourceNote: Based on your supplied security guide. This is a learning game, not a live system or a security certification.
